correctness.rationale: For 0<|c|<1, 0<s_v,s_w<2, and a=1/s_v-1/2,b=1/s_w-1/2, the adopted published stability boundary F(v,w)<=0 transforms by direct rational algebra into Phi=8a²b+4ab²-a-b>=0. With p=ab, Phi=a(8p-1)+b(4p-1), implying p>1/8. A collision damping cap q0<=q<1 imposes a,b∈[ell,1/(4ell)], ell=(1-q)/(2(1+q)). The lower chain when p<1/4 yields 8p²+(4ell²-1)p-ell²>=0, hence p>=P(ell); also p>=ell². Both branches attain and uniquely minimize via (a,b)=(ell,ell) if ell>=1/sqrt6, else (P(ell)/ell,ell), transition q*=5-2sqrt6. Third-order physical log-eigenvalue phase expansion then yields coefficient |c|(1-c²)(p-1/12) and strict infimum |c|(1-c²)/24 as q↑1. Independently checked symbolic F/Phi identity and twenty damping-cap designs.
